instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\rest_shape.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.txt in NX CAM. Use T1 to clear the main pocket in C:\Users\User\Desktop\rest_shape.step, then use T2 for Rest Milling on all small-radius corners and narrow remaining regions. The target floor is Z=6.000 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a 12 mm end mill for clearing; T2 is a 4 mm end mill for rest machining. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-08.nc. [Software] Launch Siemens NX with `C:\Program Files\Siemens\NX2306\NXBIN\ugraf.exe -nx` (adjust version/path).
